provenance: Actual browser demo sessions. Original built-in audio studies and file-review samples. Separate from the unfinished After Hours projects.

frames.title: Move through the mix
frames.caption: Three original 24-second stereo studies play together. A crossfade of 0.20 shifts the balance; the fourth deck remains empty.

frames.title: Set a cue and loop
frames.caption: Deck A starts from a four-second cue, with its level at 69% and looping enabled. The controls remain visible beside the loaded waveforms.

frames.title: Review a selected set
frames.caption: Four original sample files total 11.8 KB. Their sizes and names are visible before any decision; the review leaves the source files unchanged.

frames.title: Find identical content
frames.caption: Two 44-byte briefs share identical content: one duplicate group and 44 bytes in the extra copy. Matching is based on content, not the filename.

frames.title: Shape a listening session
frames.caption: Open Water plays from a collection of three original 24-second studies. Bass is +3 dB, mid −1 dB and treble +2 dB.

frames.title: Keep the order you chose
frames.caption: Evening studies was saved, then reloaded. Its three tracks, 03 / 01 / 02 order, playlist name and EQ settings were all retained in the browser.
